_authority: This file is the single authoritative source for the write gateway's quota numbers. gateway/write/docs/quotas-and-type-policy.md mirrors it for human readers; the protocol is gateway/write/docs/protocol.md (section 7). Where this file and the document disagree, this file wins.
_units: Bytes are authoritative. KiB means 1024 bytes. 245760 bytes = 240 KiB; 12288 bytes = 12 KiB.
_accounting: max_files and max_total_bytes count LIVE files and LIVE staged bytes. A tombstone (op=delete) frees a slot and its bytes. Content lost to isolate eviction also frees its bytes, because the bytes are gone; the cumulative bytes ever accepted and the bytes lost are reported separately by op=status.
